title: One Savings Membership per Primary Member
content:
# One Savings Membership per Primary Member

**Rule.** Under the Dental and Vision Savings Memberships, a primary member may hold only one savings membership at a time; a household membership covers the household instead of separate memberships. The number of savings memberships one primary member may hold at a time is 1.

## How the rule is applied to a purchase

- **What is checked:** a new purchase of a savings membership by a primary member.
- **Evidence:** the company's own membership records for that primary member — not the customer's account of what they hold. The records are read before the purchase is made.
- **What counts as already holding a membership:** a savings membership of the same primary member whose status is pending activation or active.

| Status of an existing savings membership of the same primary member | Counts as a membership held at this time |
|---|---|
| Pending activation | Yes |
| Active | Yes |

A savings membership in either status above means the primary member already holds one, and a second savings membership is not sold to that primary member.

## Household members

The persons of a household are covered together under one household membership (Cascade Smile Savings Household, Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Household or Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Plus Household), not under separate memberships of their own beside it.

## Illustrative cases (hypothetical)

1. A primary member's records show a Cascade Smile Savings Individual membership in active status. That primary member holds one membership; a second savings membership is not sold to them.
2. A primary member's records show a Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Household membership still pending activation. It already counts as the one membership held.
3. A primary member says they have no membership, while the records show one in active status. The records decide: the primary member holds one.
